title: Hands-Behind-Back Zig-Zag 1v1
description: Defenders guard a zig-zagging dribbler down the court with their hands clasped behind their backs, forcing them to stay in front with their feet alone.

content.objective: Contain a dribbler with footwork and body position rather than reaching.
content.setup: Pairs in lanes along the sideline thirds; the dribbler has the ball.
content.organization: Down with defense, back with offense.
instructions: The dribbler zig-zags at half speed from sideline to lane line.
The defender slides with hands behind the back, keeping the chest in front of the ball.
On each change of direction, the defender swing-steps and cuts the dribbler off.
Second trip: dribbler goes at three-quarter speed.
coachingPoints: Head on the ball: nose in front of the ball.
Beat the dribbler to the spot.
Swing step, do not cross the feet.
commonMistakes: Lunging with the body because the hands are gone.
Following behind instead of cutting off.
content.safety: Defenders play legally: chest up, no reaching across the body, no pushing; stop play on any dangerous contact.
variations: Defender must force three direction changes before half court.
Add a ball deflection allowed in the last third.
successCriteria: Dribbler turned at least three times per length.
Never beaten by more than a step.
content.gameApplication: Good defenders contain with their feet; reaching causes fouls and blow-bys.
